contributions.original_prompts:
New raw `raw/stripe-payments-swish-accept-a-payment-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw `raw/stripe-swish-accept-payment-2025.md`. Current summaries `wiki/sources/source-stripe-swish-accept-payment.md`.

- Q1. For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/swish/accept-a-payment`, what documented behavior, prerequisites, actors and state transitions does the complete new capture establish? How do these compare with the matched prior capture and each mapped summary?

- Q2. Which changes are substantive, presentational or navigation-only? Identify the exact dated qualifications, conflicts and reciprocal routes that the proposed disposition should preserve.

reviewed_answers.Q1: The November 7, 2026 capture of https://docs.stripe.com/payments/swish/accept-a-payment identifies Swish as a Swedish payment method and supplies six navigation routes (new raw lines 5-19), with no implementation prerequisites or state transitions in the base body. The May 6, 2026 guide describes single-use Swish and BankID authorization with immediate outcome, a Stripe account and eligible European Checkout payment-mode sessions with SEK line items, and both dynamic and manual selection (old raw lines 8-60). The merchant creates a Checkout Session or PaymentIntent depending on path. Browser Elements confirms the Intent client-side and uses mobile redirection or desktop QR. Direct API confirms server-side with a return URL, then hands the customer off to Swish using hosted QR/redirect instructions while the Intent requires action (old raw lines 450-452, 663-683 and 748-927). Successful authorization can lead to succeeded and the success webhook for fulfillment. Decline or no action within three minutes can detach the method and return the Intent to requires_payment_method. Browser or app return alone supplies no success proof (old raw lines 546-555, 914-927 and 982-988). source-stripe-swish-accept-payment.md retains the main web, expiry and QR behavior, but omits React Native and misstates the pre-authorization notice as Direct API only.
reviewed_answers.Q2: The difference at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/swish/accept-a-payment (new raw lines 9-19) is presentational and navigational, without evidence of a substantive payment change or renewed SDK requirements. React Native already has a full May 6, 2026 body (old raw lines 1511-1797). Correct source-stripe-swish-accept-payment.md lines 13, 17 and 28 separately from the raw delta. The claim-acquisition notice appears before authorization for Direct API and custom mobile flows while Checkout or the Payment Element display it on the merchant's behalf (old raw lines 727-735, 998-1012, 1284-1298 and 1519-1527). Preserve the native iOS custom URL or universal-link choice versus the May React Native iOS custom-scheme setup without universal links, the desktop Elements QR refresh scope, the three-minute action window and detachment on timeout or decline, and the May invite-only phone-number fallback (old raw lines 663-678, 928-932, 982-988, 1163-1197 and 1662-1672). Keep the root index to Stripe index routes and the Real-Time Payments concept's existing link back to the guide (root line 7, Stripe index lines 365 and 748, concept line 213), add the reciprocal source route and cite the dated November selector as navigation.
